chapters.title: Meet SemanticLift
chapters.text: Decades of Cognos reports hide a semantic layer. SemanticLift lifts it out onto the cloud data platform.

chapters.title: Client projects
chapters.text: Each client engagement is an isolated project, with its progress, roles and an audit trail.

chapters.title: Upload & run
chapters.text: Upload one Cognos export. Every file is detected and parsed, and stated counts are reconciled.

chapters.title: Strategy & approach
chapters.text: The playbook: for each step why it matters, what SemanticLift does, the team guideline, the outcome and this project’s figures.

chapters.title: 1. Report rationalization
chapters.text: Every report gets Keep, Review, Consolidate or Retire, with the rule and evidence behind it.

chapters.title: 2. KPI lineage
chapters.text: Trace any KPI: KPI → Framework Manager item → reports → database → schema → table.

chapters.title: 3. Common KPIs
chapters.text: KPIs that reports calculate differently are surfaced up front, and a steward approves the correct definition.

chapters.title: 4. Databases & tables
chapters.text: Only the tables surviving reports really read are in scope; tables used only by Review reports are flagged.

chapters.title: 5. Logical data model
chapters.text: A conformed model of facts and dimensions, with join-path risks diagnosed.

chapters.title: 6. Data products & semantic layer
chapters.text: Business logic leaves Cognos: semantic views, aggregated views, policies and data-product contracts.

chapters.title: 7. Object lineage
chapters.text: Every platform object traced: its sources, the semantic objects it feeds and the reports it serves.

chapters.title: Design review
chapters.text: Nothing deploys without a person. Approvers see the generated DDL next to the Cognos source.

chapters.title: Deploy & validate
chapters.text: Approved objects are committed to Git and deployed by CI; parity SQL proves the numbers still match.

chapters.title: Audit trail
chapters.text: Every upload, run and decision, attributed to a person, ready for the client’s governance team.

chapters.title: Lift the meaning
chapters.text: SemanticLift: fewer reports, one truth per KPI, a governed semantic layer, proven.
